testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, period filters, search inputs, modal triggers, table rows, export buttons, and target cells MUST include data-testid (kebab-case).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, responsive, highly professional Indonesian public health data bank app for TBC Kota Sukabumi.
Support all 12 indicators accurately with data breakdown by 33 Kelurahan in Kota Sukabumi and key Faskes (Puskesmas Selabatu, Puskesmas Cikole, Puskesmas Tipar, RSUD R. Syamsudin, SH, etc.).
Implement auto-aggregation logic: Monthly input automatically computes for Triwulan (T1-T4), Semester (S1-S2), and Tahunan.
Provide clear tabs on indicator detail pages for 'Per Kelurahan' and 'Per Faskes', containing Target Angka, Target %, Capaian Angka, Capaian %, and Total Capaian Angka & % row at the bottom.
Include export options: Excel export (.xlsx) for tables and downloadable chart images (PNG format using Recharts/Canvas capture).
Provide Admin Mode toggle with inline grid editing for updating targets and monthly achievements.
Strictly follow the color palette, typography, high-contrast dark/light mode toggle, and accessibility requirements with explicit data-testid on all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use dark colors as heavy gradients. Keep background surface clean.
Never center align the main app container globally.
Avoid AI slop, default Inter-only fonts for headers, or generic centered layout.
All interactive elements must have micro-interactions, focus rings, and explicit data-testid attributes.
Use Lucide react icons or Phosphor icons for clean tabular dashboard controls.
